changes: Adds SETTINGS > KEEP FX AWAKE. Stock, a project load or a double STOP keeps the delay and reverb silent until an audio track trigs, so the inputs get no effect.
Ticked, the effects come back for the inputs about a second later, with no track playing. A double STOP still cuts them. Unticked, nothing changes.
Like INPUT SENDS PRE, the setting is not saved and starts unticked at every power-on.
Ticked, it overrides a safety hold: high delay feedback on the inputs can build up again after a double STOP.
Known issue: pattern changes and sampling from the inputs are not yet tested with it.
First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1. SETTINGS > INPUT SENDS PRE takes the IN L and IN R delay and reverb sends before their External Mixer LEV.
An input at LEV 0 then goes fully wet to the effects. Unticked, the mixer is stock; tracks and DUAL MONO are unchanged.
The setting is not saved and starts unticked at every power-on.
